description: Moves a site to a new subdomain. The old one keeps working by redirecting to the new one, and nobody else can take it. Each site gets only a couple of changes, and a change back to an old name counts too, so use this only when the person named the new address. Requires `confirm` to repeat the site's current subdomain exactly; ask the person rather than filling it in. Visitors who signed in to the site or typed its password are asked again. Only an owner of the account can change an address.

confirm.description: The site's current subdomain, repeated exactly. A mismatch refuses the call rather than guessing which site was meant.

site.description: Subdomain or site id, from list_sites.

subdomain.description: The new subdomain, as the person gave it.

name: change_subdomain

formerSubdomains.description: The subdomains it used to answer on, newest first; each redirects here.

subdomain.description: The subdomain it answers on now.

subdomainChangesLeft.description: How many more changes its plan allows, or null when it allows any number.

title: Change a site's address
